name: Jerry Brown
desc: Governor of California from 1975 to 1983 and 2011 to 2019 (born 1938)
summary: Edmund Gerald "Jerry" Brown Jr., (born April 7, 1938) is an American lawyer, author, and politician who served as the 34th and 39th governor of California from 1975 to 1983 and 2011 to 2019. A member of the Democratic Party, he was elected secretary of state of California in 1970; Brown later served as the mayor of Oakland from 1999 to 2007 and the attorney general of California from 2007 to 2011. He was both the oldest and sixth-youngest governor of California due to the 28-year gap between his second and third terms.
